record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Chingling (2 stars, passive CHINGLING) and Chimecho (3 stars, passive CHIMECHO) declare ECHO; both range 2, maxPP 75. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index and passive. The passives are not covered here.
record.summary: Cast without a target. The base process first adds 1 to the caster's count.ult (the number of casts so far, this one included). ECHO then hits every enemy occupant in a circular area around the caster (centre excluded) with SPECIAL damage of count.ult x (3/6/9/12 by stars), so damage and radius both grow with each cast: radius is 2 + count.ult (floored, plus 0.5, strict squared-distance test). Example for the first cast (count.ult 1): radius 3, per-enemy raw damage 6 (Chingling) or 9 (Chimecho); the second cast: radius 4 and 12 / 18.

targeting.who: every occupant of cells in the radius whose team differs from the caster's
targeting.note: Team inequality is the only filter: no isTargettableBy check is made, so any occupant of another team in the area is hit (including untargettable or non-attackable ones if such states exist; not traced). Every hit uses the same amount. The caster's own cell is excluded.

geometry.shape: disc: cells with dx^2 + dy^2 < (floor(radius) + 0.5)^2 on the board, centre excluded; radius = 2 + count.ult (3 on the first cast, growing by 1 per cast)

effects.target: each enemy in the disc, once
effects.scaling: requested amount = count.ult x table value (table is per cast; count.ult is read after this cast incremented it). Then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); the crit flag is shared by all targets of the cast.
effects.resolution: applied: per target division by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF), shields and other untraced modifiers; takenDamage includes shield damage; minimum 1 after ceil. Blocked per target by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce reflects SPECIAL damage to the caster unless Protective Pads). No falloff with distance.

starBehavior.note: table value per unit at its factory stars, multiplied by count.ult at cast time. 1-star and 4-star columns are not reachable from the bare factory stars of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise star counts was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The radius is centred on the caster's cell at the moment of the cast; only the caster's position and the board occupants matter. Cells off the board are skipped.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: State kept: count.ult, a uint8 counter on the entity, incremented by every cast (any ability, since the increment is in the base process) and reset to 0 only in the VOLT_SURGE revive path found; it is not reset for ECHO. Its starting value for a fight-created entity is the Count default 0 (entity construction not traced). The uint8 type would wrap after 255 casts (not reachable in practice, not verified).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: count.ult x 6 (Chingling) or x 9 (Chimecho) per enemy, e.g. 6 / 9 on the first cast and 12 / 18 on the second. Applied per target: x (1 + AP/100), crit factor if the cast crit, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; takenDamage reported by handleDamage includes shield damage.
